name: LocalTry
summary: CRM for service businesses and agencies that combines customers, jobs, scheduling, invoices, reviews and marketing with an AI assistant that can also be reached through MCP.
best_for: small service businesses and agencies that want customers, jobs, invoices, reviews and marketing in one CRM and would like to connect their own AI tool
skip_if: you want a trial without a card, you need a refund option, or you want to know the setup cost before you start
honest_knock: A card is needed even for the 3-day trial, and incurred charges are normally non-refundable. A $999 setup charge was only waived for a limited time, and the dedicated ChatGPT plugin is still listed as coming soon.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-10 on localtry.com/pricing) LocalTry has three plans that all include the same 133 capabilities and differ by team size and workspace count: Core is $59 a month for 2 users and 1 workspace, Operator is $99 a month for 5 users and 15 workspaces, and Scale is $199 a month for 10 users and 50 workspaces. Each plan starts with a 3-day free trial, and the page says to add a card through Stripe and that your first charge comes after the trial unless you cancel. The page also shows a $999 setup, customization and data-transfer charge that was free for the next 7 days at the time we read it; that is a promotion and not part of the subscription price, so ask what it costs once the offer ends. The pricing page says there is no plan-based cap on AI actions, but provider usage limits apply. The terms say paid subscriptions renew for the selected period until cancelled and that incurred charges are normally non-refundable. Prices are in US dollars; we did not open checkout, so the tax added is not known.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested LocalTry in the 3-day trial that we started with our card, which runs on Operator at $99 a month. A customer and a draft estimate worked, a job needed three attempts, and the AI assistant could not finish a simple draft. The in-app cancel button failed three times with a server error; cancelling worked in the Stripe portal, where the merchant has another name. Account and start: we created the account and started the 3-day trial with his own card; the trial runs on LocalTry Operator. No phone number was asked. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser on 19 November 2026 from 15:08. The interface was in English, but dates in the app were in Dutch, so images with such a date are not in the evidence. The workspace asked for a business type (Service business) and offered six connections, of which 2 of 6 were done; the other four were skipped with Enter workspace. Pages loaded slowly, 5 to 15 seconds of Loading workspace each. Core action, a customer, a job, a draft estimate and the AI assistant, from 15:09 to 15:25, about 16 minutes: a test customer with an example address was saved in about 5 seconds. Creating a job failed twice: Create job stayed grey and no job appeared; the third attempt made Boiler check visit (test), scheduled, not linked to the customer. On the way, which messages the customer, was not clicked. A draft estimate with one custom item of 1 x $120 was created (EST-2026-A5642E created, status draft, $120.00); it was not e-mailed, signed or turned into an invoice. Command, the AI assistant, got a request to draft a follow-up message without sending anything. It first replied that it would draft it, then after about 70 seconds: I could not finish that command. The hosted Command model could not finish this turn. No draft came back. The reviews page was empty and was not used. Settings lists many connections (texting, social, WordPress, Shopify, Stripe, QuickBooks and more); none was touched. Plans: Settings, Membership & billing shows LocalTry Operator, Membership billed through Stripe, Status Free trial, a trial end on 22 November 2026 at 15:01 CET, and Cancel before your trial ends to prevent the monthly membership from starting. Your remaining trial access stays available. No amount is shown there. The public pricing page shows OPERATOR $99 / month, 3 days free. $0 charged today. 5 users and 15 workspaces, the $999 setup FREE for the next 7 days, and an invitation code route that needs no card; Core ($59) and Scale ($199) were not in the text we read. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen. Cancelling, done the same day: in the app, Membership & billing, Cancel trial opens a dialog that says the trial will end without starting the monthly membership and that the workspace is not deleted; no reason, no offer, no password. But the final Cancel trial did not work: three attempts, the dialog stayed open, the request returned HTTP 500 and the status stayed Free trial. The working route was Invoices & payment method, which opens the Stripe customer portal of the merchant Market Nest - VL, not LocalTry: Cancel subscription, an optional reason, Cancel subscription again. The portal then marked the plan to be cancelled on 22 Nov, with the service ending after the trial on 22 November 2026; the invoice history shows only a US$ 0.00 trial invoice, and the plan is US$ 99.00 per month. Not tested: review requests or texts, e-mail campaigns, social posts, the Stripe, Twilio and Google connections, a domain, MCP, deleting the account and sending an invoice. Clean up: the test customer, the job and the draft estimate stay. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Pages took 5 to 15 seconds to load, creating a job failed twice, and the AI assistant failed on a simple draft. The in-app cancel button failed, and the Stripe portal shows the merchant as Market Nest - VL, which a buyer may not recognise on a statement.
